text:
Kevin H.: Heads-up — OmniCloud wants to run a 2-week joint pilot (LLM chat + embeddings) with a shared sandbox. They care about 99th percentile latency < 400ms, token cost targets, and SSO/KMS. Can we align on tenant + entitlement + pricing checklist?
Maria L.: on it. need tenant vpc/subnet details and partner sso type (SAML/OIDC).
Tara (Sales): Partner asked if we can offer a short term committed burst for first week. also pricing question: do we give discounted dev credits or a temporary T0 rate?
Sophie - OmniCloud: Thanks — SAML for SSO. We'll need IP allowlist and an option to bring our KMS (HSM). Burst capacity for week1 would help validate latency at scale. Pricing flexibility is important.
Kevin H.: Thanks Sophie. Quick plan: 1) Provision sandbox tenant (isolated VPC) 2) Enable SAML SSO + test SP metadata 3) Offer 100k dev tokens + configurable burst capacity (up to 2x) 4) Default model redirection to a q4/8 quantized variant for cost/latency 5) Telemetry hooks + per-route token breakdown.
deploy-bot: tenant-acme-omni-1759876543 created by infra-provisioner — staging URL: https://staging.redwood.example/tenants/omni-acme
Maria L.: Can you share the SAML metadata and contact for your IdP admin? Also will Omni bring KMS keys or do you want Redwood-managed CMEK?
Sophie - OmniCloud: Sending IdP metadata now (uploaded to shared drive). We plan to bring our KMS for keys-in-use (HSM). Is that supported in private sandbox?
Kevin H.: We support customer-managed keys in private and dedicated profiles. For hosted sandbox we can proxy with a wrapped key; for full HSM we need Private deployment sign-off (security review).
Tara (Sales): To unblock pricing, propose: - Week1 burst included - 25% dev credit off hosted rate for pilot - post-pilot committed discount if they convert. Thoughts?
Maria L.: Technical blockers: 1) IP whitelisting for KV cache endpoints 2) Ensure prefix caching doesn't leak tenant context 3) Verify model variant availability across regions (we need EU region for Omni)
Sophie - OmniCloud: EU region required. Also can you provide a short runbook for on-call contact during load tests?
Kevin H.: I'll draft a runbook. include: load test window, expected QPS, fallback model variant, circuit-breaker thresholds. Example config snippet for routing policy: 
```
route_policy:
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  fallback: us-west-2
  model_fallback: gptq-4x-8q
  burst_limit: 2.0
  slo_99_latency_ms: 400
```
Maria L.: Also adding checklist for security questionnaire: SOC2 scope, encryption-at-rest, KMS integration flow, data retention, and audit log access. Sophie — can you confirm compliance contacts?
Sophie - OmniCloud: Compliance: me (Sophie) + Raj (security@omnicloud.com). We'll fill out the questionnaire by EOD Friday.
Tara (Sales): I'll draft the commercial term sheet and attach the pilot pricing. Kevin/Maria — please add technical notes to the attachment.
Kevin H.: Quick note on telemetry — we can add a per-route trace header: X-Redwood-Trace: <trace-id> and stream to partner telemetry. Need partner ingestion endpoint.
Sophie - OmniCloud: Partner ingestion endpoint: https://ingest.omni-secure.com/pilot. We will share cert for mTLS.
Maria L.: Security follow-up: do we need an architecture diagram for their legal review? I'll make a minimal diagram and attach.
Tara (Sales): calendar: booked 30m tech sync Thu 10:30PT — invite includes infra, solutions, and partner security.
Kevin H.: flagging one potential enterprise blocker: HSM in hosted mode will require DPA addendum and extra audit steps. If they insist on full HSM, timeline moves +3 weeks.
Sophie - OmniCloud: Aware — we'll scope staged: start with tenant-proxying for keys, iterate to HSM if pilot metrics warrant.
Maria L.: I uploaded the preliminary runbook and the SSO test plan to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example/s/omni-acme-pilot. Please review.
Kevin H.: I'll run a quick smoke test tonight against staging URL and post results.
deploy-bot: smoke-test: ok — baseline 95th latency 180ms, 99th 360ms (small sample).
Tara (Sales): great — looks like the initial numbers are in range. I'll move pricing draft to partner review. :thumbsup:
Sophie - OmniCloud: Thanks all. We'll start SSO tests tomorrow. raj@omnicloud.com will join Thu call for security specifics.
Kevin H.: Closing notes: I'll send a short tech summary after Thu call and include any updated runbook steps.
Maria L.: Thanks team — keeping this thread for async updates. :sparkles:
